consequence.statement: The metric cilium_node_connectivity_status is deprecated, and consumers should move to cilium_node_health_connectivity_status.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries to use cilium_node_health_connectivity_status instead of cilium_node_connectivity_status.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric cilium_node_connectivity_status is deprecated, and users should switch to cilium_node_health_connectivity_status.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The subject is a Prometheus metric name (cilium_node_connectivity_status), and no subject family covers metrics.; applicability: Exposure depends on whether dashboards, alerts or queries outside the cluster configuration use this metric. No configuration predicate can read that, and the evidence names no setting that controls it.
